title: Congress replaces Bhupesh Baghel with Sachin Pilot as Punjab general secretary
content:
Sachin Pilot replaces Bhupesh Baghel as Congress gereral secretary for Punjab

NEW DELHI: The Congress on Saturday appointed Sachin Pilot as the party’s general secretary in-charge of Punjab, replacing Bhupesh Baghel, news agency PTI reported. The appointment comes as Congress prepares to strengthen its organisation and political strategy in the state ahead of the Punjab assembly elections. Congress had appointed former Chhattisgarh chief minister Bhupesh Baghel as an AICC general secretary and made him the party’s Punjab in-charge in 2025. A prominent OBC leader, Baghel was credited with helping revive the Congress in Chhattisgarh and led the party to a landslide victory in the 2018 assembly elections. He served as chief minister from 2018 to 2023, with his tenure focusing on pro-farmer policies and rural development. Congress, however, lost the 2023 Chhattisgarh polls to the BJP, with Vishnu Deo Sai subsequently becoming chief minister.

title: Panun Kashmir stages hunger strike, demands genocide law
content:
A displaced Kashmiri Pandit organisation Saturday observed a day-long hunger strike

JAMMU: A displaced Kashmiri Pandit organisation Saturday observed a day-long hunger strike demanding the creation of a separate homeland in the valley for their rehabilitation and enactment of a genocide law. Panun Kashmir chairperson Tito Ganju said India, as a signatory to the UN Genocide Convention, was obligated to enact a dedicated law dealing with genocide. The organisation’s demands included official recognition of the genocide of Kashmiri Pandits, passage of a Genocide Bill, creating a separate Union Territory as a secure homeland in the valley, creation of 15,000 jobs in central govt departments for unemployed and over-aged youth, and enhancement of ex gratia assistance and monthly relief.
